column11: the programme is finished and failed. SELECT-1 (NCT01933932, 510 participants, selumetinib plus docetaxel in second-line KRAS-mutant NSCLC) reached primary completion on 2016-06-07 and its posted registry results give median progression-free survival of 3.9 months against 2.8 months on placebo plus docetaxel, hazard ratio 0.93 (95% CI 0.77 to 1.12), P=0.4355, and median overall survival 8.7 against 7.9 months, hazard ratio 1.05 (95% CI 0.85 to 1.30), P=0.6431. Published as Janne et al., JAMA 2017 (jamanetwork.com/journals/jama/fullarticle/2625317). The registry still reads 'Active, not recruiting', which is why the book carried it as a Phase 3 in progress
